messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION in us-west-2 (spot pools) — queue length rising, throttling started, some requests 503. Metric snapshot: queued_requests=1.2k, running_jobs=760, pool_util=98%
Maria Chen: I got the pager. Observed sudden spike in queued inference requests and autoscaler didn't add nodes — looks like HPA at max_nodes=100. Can oncall confirm?
oncall-bot: @Maria Chen you are on-call for infra. Please acknowledge.
Maria Chen: ack. Starting triage.
Ashwin Patel: I'm checking autoscaler logs now. Seeing repeated `scaleUp` attempts fail due to quota errors: 
```
Error: quotaExceeded: Insufficient vGPU quota for requested machine type
Request: create 10 n1-standard-32 with a100
```
Maria Chen: so cloud quota blocking new instances — that explains lack of fallback. Any spot-preempt logs?
SRE Pager: spot-interruption events spiked at 2067889900..2067890000 in us-west-2, ~45% of instances reclaimed in spot pools.
Kai Rodriguez: We also have image-pull backoff on some transient nodes (private registry rate limit) — combined failure surface.
Leah O'Neill: Customer impact: increased response latency and 10-15% error rate for hosted API keys routing to us-west-2. Some customers hitting retry loops.
Matt Park: Posting a status update draft to status page in case we need it. Suggested wording: "Degraded performance in us-west-2 due to GPU capacity; autoscaling is blocked. Working on mitigation."
Maria Chen: Short-term mitigations we can try now: (1) divert new traffic away from us-west-2 to eu-west-1 / us-east-1 routing rules, (2) reduce request concurrency per connection (throttle) to shed load, (3) manually spin on-demand instances in a separate pool if quota allows.
Ashwin Patel: Trying to increase autoscaler max_nodes to 150 to see if any headroom exists, but cloud quota check failing. Running `gcloud compute regions describe us-west-2 --project=redwood-infer` to confirm quotas.
Ashwin Patel: result: GPUs quota for A100 family at region is 120 (we're at 116), so increasing nodes won't help — quota is the blocker.
Maria Chen: OK. Action: Kai, can you create a temporary policy to route 40% of traffic off us-west-2 to other regions? Use route policy `region_preference` and reduce weight for us-west-2.
Kai Rodriguez: On it. Pushing routing change now.
Kai Rodriguez: Pushed: `route set weight us-west-2=60 eu-west-1=30 us-east-1=10`. Should converge in ~30s.
SRE Pager: Traffic steering applied. Metrics: queued_requests in us-west-2 dropped 20% after routing change. Latency for routed requests rising slightly in eu-west-1 but within SLOs.
Leah O'Neill: Good. Next, we need to address customers on Dedicated capacity pinned to us-west-2 — they won't follow routing. Any dedicated customers affected?
Maria Chen: Checking list... two enterprise tenants pinned to us-west-2. Reached out to their account reps to propose failover to dedicated replica in us-east-1.
Matt Park: For immediate relief, recommend enabling short-term request-level backoff for all clients in us-west-2 via header injection: `X-Client-Backoff: 200` to reduce burstiness. Can we gate that by tenancy?
Ashwin Patel: We can add a dynamic config rule in the API gateway. Applying now.
Ashwin Patel: Rule applied. Observed a 35% reduction in new queued requests from aggressive clients.
Maria Chen: Supplementary mitigation: spin a small on-demand pool in eu-west-1 and mark it as fallback for us-west-2 traffic. Kai, please coordinate with eng-runtime to ensure model variants are available on the new pool.
Kai Rodriguez: Created instance template and started 12 on-demand nodes with A100. Image pulls are succeeding (using cached image). Eng-runtime notified to attach model shards.
SRE Pager: New nodes came up; kube nodes Ready. Pod startup slowed by KV cache warming but we're seeing capacity add.
Leah O'Neill: Customer impact now reduced to ~2-4% elevated error for a minority of keys. Update status page draft and tell account reps.
Maria Chen: Root cause hypothesis: synchronized spot preemptions + regional GPU quota limits + container image pull throttling prevented autoscaler from recovering. Combined failure mode.
Matt Park: Agree. Next steps: (1) escalate quota to cloud provider (opened support ticket CP-987654), (2) increase buffer for spot fallback by reserving small on-demand headroom in each region, (3) add regional circuit-breaker to shift traffic automatically when queued_requests > 500 for >5m, (4) fix image distribution to avoid rate limits (push to multi-registry caches).
Ashwin Patel: Logging ticket for autoscaler to surface quota errors earlier and avoid fruitless scaleUp loops. Ticket INF-4321.
Kai Rodriguez: I'll prepare runbook updates for on-call: include steps to change route weights, spin fallback pool, apply client backoff rule, and handoff template to product.
Maria Chen: Good. Handoff: I'm going to sleep in 45m. Ashwin will be primary until next rotation. @Ashwin Patel you'll take lead on the incident until resolved.
Ashwin Patel: Got it. I'll monitor for next 2 hours and coordinate with cloud support.
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged handoff: Maria Chen -> Ashwin Patel.
SRE Pager: If we see more than two additional preemption waves, we should trigger org-level escalation.
Leah O'Neill: I'll compile a customer impact spreadsheet and list which tenants had errors and duration.
Matt Park: I'll publish the public status update: "Degraded performance affecting some API requests in us-west-2. We've rerouted traffic and are adding fallback capacity. No data exposure. Working on full remediation."
Maria Chen: Thanks team — current status: traffic rerouted, on-demand fallback pool active, autoscaler still gated by quota. Reducing error rate to single digits. Continuing monitoring.
Ashwin Patel: Follow-up actions assigned: INF-4321 (autoscaler errors), CP-987654 (quota increase), OPS-582 (image cache replication). I'll post updates in this thread.
Maria Chen: Closing primary triage loop for now. Please keep this thread alive with updates. :thumbsup:
SRE Pager: Incident thread will remain open until on-demand fallback capacity stabilized for 24h
notes: post-incident: follow up with cloud quotas and model distribution caching.
